answer.thought: The headlines sit on the step like dropped coins. An eighty percent vaccination rate in the girls of India; a criminal contempt case in Calcutta. One is the state acting to preserve the body of the people, the other the state acting to preserve the dignity of the law. The former is a universal measure, the latter a particular conflict. The state is the actuality of the ethical idea, but here it is still learning to walk.
